# API Requirements Quality Checklist: Ticket Management REST API

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, and consistency of the API-facing requirements (spec.md + api-contract.md) before `/speckit-tasks` decomposes them into implementation work
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [api-contract.md](../api-contract.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are request/response schemas defined for every endpoint listed in api-contract.md's Endpoint summary, not just the primary ones? [Completeness, api-contract.md]
- [x] CHK002 Are the required vs. optional fields for ticket creation explicitly enumerated somewhere the reviewer can check against FR-001? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behavior when a client omits the `Content-Type` header or sends a non-JSON body documented? [Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Are HTTP method/verb choices justified for every action (e.g. why `POST .../transitions` instead of `PATCH status`)? [Completeness, api-contract.md]
- [x] CHK005 Is a maximum page `size` cap documented so "unbounded array" (Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases) cannot be defeated by a large `size` value? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "keyword" in FR-006 unambiguous about whether it matches partial words, whole words, or requires exact substring containment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Is the exact set of fields eligible for partial update in FR-004 distinguished clearly from the field that is explicitly excluded (`status`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec/contract define what "enough detail to identify the offending field(s)" (FR-011) means in a testable way (e.g., a required `details[].field` value)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is "structured 400-style error" in the Edge Cases section reconciled with the exact status codes used elsewhere (400 vs 422) so there's one unambiguous rule? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do FR-009's transition list and state-machine.md's valid-transition table agree on every entry, with no silent extra or missing edge? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Is the error code used for an invalid status transition (`INVALID_TRANSITION`, 409) consistent between api-contract.md and FR-011's general "structured error" requirement? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK012 Do the list/search/filter requirements (FR-002, FR-006, FR-007) agree on whether they share one endpoint or are separate, avoiding contradictory path/verb assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/006/007]
- [x] CHK013 Is the "not-found" requirement (FR-012) applied consistently to every resource-by-id operation (get, update, transition, comment), with no operation silently exempted? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-006 ("zero unrelated tickets in the result set") be verified without ambiguity about what counts as "unrelated" when a keyword appears in only part of a compound word? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-004 ("zero partial writes to storage") independently verifiable per endpoint, or only asserted in aggregate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Are success criteria defined for the comment-add flow specifically, or only implied by SC-001/SC-004 for tickets in general? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the primary flow, error flow, and not-found flow for every one of the 6 endpoints in api-contract.md? [Coverage]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for submitting a `PATCH` update with an empty body (no fields at all)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a transition request naming the ticket's own current status (a same-state "transition")? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for concurrent requests attempting to transition the same ticket at the same time? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Is the response defined for a search `q` parameter that is present but empty (`?q=`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK022 Is behavior defined for a `page`/`size` value that is negative or non-numeric? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK023 Is behavior defined for a ticket ID that is syntactically invalid (not a well-formed identifier) versus one that is well-formed but not found — are these distinguished? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK024 Is the "unknown fields in request body" edge case (Spec §Edge Cases) reconciled with the `status`-field-in-PATCH rejection rule in api-contract.md so both use the same error code? [Consistency, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Are any response-time/latency expectations documented for list/search endpoints, or is "no explicit target" an intentional, recorded decision? [Gap, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK026 Are idempotency requirements defined for `POST /tickets/{id}/transitions` and `POST /tickets/{id}/comments` (e.g., retried request behavior)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Are concurrency/versioning requirements (e.g., optimistic locking on update) documented, or explicitly deferred? [Gap, Assumption]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 Is the assumption that `assignee` requires no roster validation (Spec §Assumptions) reflected consistently in every endpoint that accepts an `assignee` value? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that pagination defaults are "implementation defaults, not a fixed business rule" (Spec §Assumptions) compatible with SC-006/SC-007's testability, given default page size could hide results in a test? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK030 Is there any remaining ambiguity between "no enforced max length" (Clarifications) and the general request to "reject malformed input" — i.e., is an extremely large payload malformed or merely long? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
